name: A Shifty Merchant
summary: In Gadgetzan, Mux Manascrambler has a core for his device but still needs a rod to carry its force without melting. He remembers an imp in Winterspring who offered an elemental rod, and regrets not buying it. You find the imp in a cave at Darkwhisper Gorge’s entrance and buy the Fel Elemental Rod.

sections.title: The Imp in the Cave
sections.body:
Mux Manascrambler has the core for his device, but still needs a rod that can carry its force without melting. After A Portable Power Source, he recalls an elemental rod an imp was selling in Winterspring. Mux regrets not buying it then.

The imp is in a cave at the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring. You buy the Fel Elemental Rod and bring it to Mux in Gadgetzan. He says the imp quoted him forty gold and insists you pay no more.

sections.title: The Rod Arrives
sections.body: Mux is delighted with the rod and says it will do perfectly. Then he turns to putting everything together.

faq.q: Who sends you after the rod?
faq.answer: Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan, Tanaris, sends you to find the rod.
This follows A Portable Power Source.

faq.q: Where can the imp merchant be found?
aliases: where is the merchant in winterspring
faq.answer: The imp merchant is in a cave at the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring.

faq.q: What item are you sent to purchase?
faq.answer: You are sent to buy a Fel Elemental Rod.

faq.q: How much does the rod cost?
faq.answer: The imp quoted Mux forty gold, and Mux wants you charged no more.

faq.q: Why does Mux need this rod?
faq.answer: The core will power Mux’s device, but he still needs a rod that can carry its force without melting.
